content: विभिन्न {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Broken asunder, divided, split. .²2 Pierced, wounded. .²3 Dispelled, driven away, dispersed. .²4 Perplexed, bewildered. .²5 Moved to and fro. .²6 Disappointed. .²7 Different, various. .²8 Mixed, blended, variegated; विभिन्नवर्णा गरुडाग्रजेन सूर्यस्य रथ्याः परितः स्फुरन्त्या <ls>Śi. 4. 14</ls>. .²9 Manifested, displayed. .²10 Become faithless. .{@-न्नः@} <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva.
